body: Advisor: please do not update-branch or merge main into PRs that are approved or have a full run in flight (standing order, 2026-11-14 06:30). At 19:54 #4117 (now e9bdc47) and #4126 (now ad81fd0) were updated from main while train #4132 carried them at their approved heads 02b1bf6 and 5b4342a. The train may now refuse at landing on the moved heads, and both approvals sit on the old heads. Main track PRs need no base refresh: the train builds the merge itself. The fast-compile red on those PRs came from a superseded run and does not block the train. Please leave #4122 and #4124 as they are too; #4124 is held anyway, waiting on TASK-3805. I will report what #4132 does.
subject: STOP updating approved PRs from main: #4117/#4126 are mid-train
